name: seuif97
description: High-speed IAPWS-IF97 water/steam properties calculation in WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --features wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/seuif97.wasm --out-dir pkg --target web
scripts.build:wasm:node: cargo build --release --features wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/seuif97.wasm --out-dir pkg --target nodejs

author: Cheng Maohua <cmh@seu.edu.cn>
